text:
Rae: Quick capture from midday design sync about model catalog compare UX. Short thread.

Diego: Problem recap: compact filters collide with table header on narrow screens, pin affordance is too subtle, and badges are ambiguous in color/meaning.

Priya: Proposal: collapse filters into a single chevron row under 920px. Keep them keyboard-accessible with aria-expanded on the chevron.

Nora: Add a skip link for SR users when filters are collapsed: 'Skip to filters'. Also ensure focus lands inside filter panel when expanded.

Jun: Badge note: the yellow 'fast' pill fails contrast. Use darker text or a 1px outline and add aria-labels like 'Performance: low latency'.

Rae: Pin discoverability: replace tiny pin icon with a compact toggle that shows 'Pinned' on hover and has aria-pressed. Also show a tiny toast: 'Version pinned 27' with undo.

Diego: For compare mode toolbar: move to top-right to avoid covering first column, and add a keyboard shortcut 't' to focus it. We'll document shortcut in a first-time tooltip.

Priya: Responsive fallback: on <1100px convert table to stacked cards where name sits above metrics; keep pin as an inline button.

Nora: QA checklist items: filter collapse a11y, skip link focus, badge aria-labels, pin aria-pressed + toast undo, keyboard shortcut 't' behavior. I'll write tests for these.

Jun: Design will mock compact filter row, legend for badges, and the promoted pin toggle. Expect mocks by EOD.

Rae: Action owners: Design (Priya) mocks, FE (Diego) keyboard + responsive changes, QA (Nora) tests. Revisit after PRs. :thumbsup:
